audit.method: Direct model translation followed by a complete source-target editorial reading of twenty ExtraDialogue records covering Pierre, villager, and Willy purchased-item reactions plus all dumpster-diving comments. Every placeholder, quantity, price, quality judgment, food and fish description, character-specific voice, shop name, and control marker was reviewed against its key context and the canonical Ukrainian glossary. Keys, placeholders, dialogue delimiters, emotion markers, and non-text payloads were preserved. Remaining ExtraDialogue records and full-locale final audits remain pending.
